card.name: The letter g starting a word
card.fires_on: The single letter g (or G) when it is the first piece of a longer word that is split up, such as gulls, garrison, gleaning, gastrointestinal. It fires in general prose and in label headings.

modes.label: Lowercase g in prose
modes.description: A lowercase g begins a word like gulls, garrison, glee or grieved after a short word such as the.
modes.example: except for the<< g>>ulls. Gulls are smart birds.

modes.label: Capital G in headings
modes.description: A capital G begins Gastrointestinal at the start of a sentence or heading.

card.writes: It promotes word endings that follow a g, such as uide, uard, overnment, rowth and ateway, to complete words like guide, guard, government and growth.
card.plain: It marks a word that has just begun with the letter g and is not yet finished.
